name: CDC Beard 1 (BE1)

address.value: 23 Tantalum Street, Beard ACT 2620 (Block 25 Section 11 Beard)
address.note: street address from ACT cadastre (ACTGOV_BLOCKS ADDRESSES field for Block 25 Sec 11 Beard); block area 47,644 sqm (4.764 ha). DA describes site as corner of Copper Cl/Crescent and Nickel St, access from Tantalum St; the approved works also covered Blocks 7-8 Section 1 Beard

lat.note: Centroid of the ACT cadastre polygon for Block 25 Section 11 Beard (ACTmapi ArcGIS REST ACTGOV_BLOCKS/FeatureServer/0, query DIVISION_NAME='BEARD' AND SECTION_NUMBER=11 AND BLOCK_NUMBER=25, outSR=4326; returnCentroid and a computed area-weighted polygon centroid agree to <1 m), 2026-09-27. Block-level point; the BE1 building occupies the northern part of the block (BE2 site is the undeveloped southern ~9,010 sqm)

builder.note: head contractor not found in DA documents or CDC/Infratil material; Green Civil Australia delivered civil works (source 6, search snippet)

mw_it.note: CDC Canberra page: Beard campus (BE1) 'Total capacity 39 MW'; Infratil investor day Mar 2024 lists Canberra under construction 39 MW (= BE1, source 11). Alternatives: Stantec traffic report for BE2 DA (Mar 2026) calls BE1 'a 35 MW, two storey data centre with 10 data halls' (source 9); ABC Aug 2026 says 40 MW (source 4); Infratil 2025 cites 110 MW for Beard (whole campus incl. BE2)

cost_aud_m.note: not found; the '$200 million' figure is for Beard 2 (BE2), a separate DA (202645149)

pathway.value: Development application, merit track (ACT Planning and Development Act 2007)

reference.note: building DA: 'stage 1 construction of a data centre comprising of two (2) storey building with 10 data halls, a storage and ancillary office area, on-site building backup electricity generators, electrical substation, site access from Tantalum Street, on-site car parking...' at Blocks 7-8 and 25 Sections 1 and 11 Beard. Earlier siteworks DA 202341501 (earthworks, stormwater, utilities, civil works; lodged 2023-05-17, approved 2023-07-17, source 2). Stage 2 (BE2) is DA 202645149, lodged 2026-08-20, under assessment

determined.note: Notice of Decision signed 3 Oct 2023: approved subject to conditions (delegate Joshua Dobing); further information lodged 28 Jun and 24 Aug 2023

jobs_operational_other.note: 'It is anticipated that up to 54 staff members may be present on the site at any one time' - whole Beard site BE1+BE2 once BE2 is built (Stantec transport assessment for BE2 DA, Mar 2026; also Region Canberra, source 5). Includes customers, security and visitors; not BE1 alone
staff table: 'CDC Staff/Customers (Daytime 8am-5pm) 25 BE1', plus 5 CDC shift staff (24h), 4 security staff and 5 visitors shared between BE1/BE2. Mixes staff and customers, so not a jobs count

construction_start.note: CDC Mar 2026 investor presentation timeline: '2024 Beard - CDC's fourth Canberra campus begins construction'. Siteworks DA approved Jul 2023 and building DA Oct 2023, so site works may have started late 2023

construction_end.note: not dated: Infratil investor day Mar 2024 still listed BE1 as under construction (source 11); CDC Mar 2026 presentation lists 'Completed work at BK2, BE1 and HV2' and shows BE1 as operational (source 3); Stantec Mar 2026 says BE1 'is now operational' and the BE2 Development Outcomes Report says BE1 'was completed as part of the Stage 1 works' (sources 9,10). So completed between Mar 2024 and Mar 2026 (Baxtel/DCM say 2025). ABC Aug 2026 says still being fitted out

open_questions: completion date: between Mar 2024 and Mar 2026 (2025 per Baxtel/DCM), not confirmed
